tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description:
Search Afefehub for reviewed businesses by name, dish, product, service or area.

Args:
    query: free text, e.g. "suya", "Mama Cass", "braids Lekki"
    country: optional ISO-3166 alpha-2 code, e.g. NG, GH, KE
    city: optional city to narrow the search, e.g. Lagos
    category: optional category

tools.name: get_business
tools.description:
Summary and every review of one business on Afefehub.

Args:
    business: the business url (https://afefehub.com/b/...), its slug, or its business_id

tools.name: top_businesses
tools.description:
Best-reviewed businesses in a country, optionally in one city and category
(e.g. best restaurants in Lagos: country="NG", city="Lagos", category="restaurant").

Ranked by the share of reviewers who recommend the place, with a small prior so one review
cannot top the list, blended with the 1-5 star a

tools.name: how_to_submit_review
tools.description: How someone can add their own review of a business to Afefehub.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_business, top_businesses · Public sink: top_businesses, how_to_submit_review.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_business, top_businesses · Public sink: top_businesses, how_to_submit_review

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
